purpose: Freeze a larger label-blind source/tile corpus for actual upstream Source Extractor/PSFEx morphology replay after the direct moment-surrogate branch was negatively certified. Selection uses only the already-frozen 2F-A structural_cluster and anomaly_score fields plus src_id deterministic tie-breaks; no pixel morphology or external temporal/human/environment labels may influence membership.

selection_contract.typical_rule: Within each frozen structural_cluster, compute the median frozen anomaly_score. Sort by absolute distance to that median, then src_id ascending; take the first 16.
selection_contract.unusual_rule: Exclude the 16 typical sources. Sort remaining rows by frozen anomaly_score descending then src_id ascending; take the first 16.

expected_pre_pixel_topology.note: These counts are deterministic consequences of applying the selection rule to the already-frozen C0M map and are frozen before any C2A pixels are replayed.

sample_freeze_gates.row_count: Exactly 512 rows and 512 unique src_id values.
sample_freeze_gates.topology: Exactly 360 distinct tile_id and 234 distinct plate_id values.
sample_freeze_gates.parent_membership: Every selected src_id must occur exactly once in the frozen 122,820-row C0M acquisition map.
sample_freeze_gates.external_label_firewall: Selection code and manifest must contain no nuclear, Blue Book, NUFORC, Kp/ap, lunar or solar temporal labels.

post_freeze_rule: After the manifest hashes are committed, C2A pixel replay may use only the exact frozen 512 sources and the exact union of their 360 tiles. Failed tiles/sources remain failures; no replacement sources or tiles may be selected.
